title: Chunk Index (parquet column schema)
description: Per-patient offset table. One row per chunk. No chunk text stored — retrieval reads text from structured/<source_file>.parquet using (row_id, source_column) plus (char_start, char_end). Sidecar sibling chunk_index.parquet.meta.json carries the artifact envelope.

const.name: chunk_id
const.description: Stable canonical id: f'{patient_id}:{source_file_stem}:{row_id}:{chunk_idx}'

const.name: patient_id
const.description: Folder name of the patient in raw/.

const.name: source_file
const.description: Relative path of the source CSV under the patient folder.

const.name: source_stem
const.description: Extension-stripped stem of source_file; the {patient}:{stem}:{row}:... component of chunk_id and the source key for :TABLE chunk resolution.

const.name: row_id
const.description: 0-based row index in the preserved parquet for that source file.

const.name: source_column
const.description: Column name within the row whose text was embedded.

const.name: source_text_sha256
const.description: sha256 of the FULL source row text (not the chunk) — a row-text fingerprint for audit/provenance.

const.name: chunk_idx
const.description: 0-based chunk index within that (row, column).

const.name: char_start
const.description: Character offset (inclusive) within source_column text.

const.name: char_end
const.description: Character offset (exclusive) within source_column text.

const.name: token_count
const.description: Number of tokens in this chunk under the encoder's tokenizer.

const.name: parent_tokens
const.description: Total tokens in the parent row.source_column text.

const.name: num_chunks
const.description: Total number of chunks this row.source_column was split into.

const.name: document_date
const.description: Document date for the source row, auto-detected from a date-like column (date/note_date/document_date/...). Null when no such column exists.

const.name: age
const.description: Patient age at the document, from the column this site's map names (for example `age`). The de-identified time axis an export usually ships beside the date; null when the source carries no such column.

const.name: doc_type
const.description: Document type for the source row, auto-detected (type/doc_type/note_type/...). Null when absent.

const.name: encounter_id
const.description: Encounter/accession id for the source row, auto-detected (pat_enc_csn_id/encounter_id/...). Null when absent.

const.name: author
const.description: Author/provider for the source row (who wrote it), from the configured author column or auto-detected (author/provider_name/...). Null when absent.

const.name: linked_author
const.description: Co-signer / linked author for the source row, from the configured column or auto-detected (linked_author/...). Null when absent.

const.name: title
const.description: Document title for the source row (e.g. the note title), from the configured column or auto-detected (title/note_title/...). Null when absent.

const.name: specialty
const.description: Clinical specialty or service the document belongs to, from the column this site's chunk_metadata_columns maps (for example dept_specialty / pat_service). Null when the source carries no such column — most note tables do not.
